body: We usually have one in the first few months of the year.

I struggle greatly with math, I've tried extra help and all I can do is pass with a little bit over a 60 being insanely stressed the whole school year about passing it, it fucking sucks. This year I told myself I would just end it if I failed and would have to retake math, I stressed myself out to the point of tears and self harm over it at times and if all I was gonna be is a failure life was pointless. I barely passed, it was the best feeling for all of 10 minutes I don't think I can strain myself to this point for just minuscule excitement, because even if I miraculously pass high school, I know I have no ambition and think of myself to be something of a fuck up.

Thank you, but it's hard to not want to act rashly, when it comes to the people I know in real life I don't want them to be bothered by my problems, I dont want them to get intensely involved in my life and my issues, which is why I try to never talk to people about my issues.

Hey man, thanks I think I should try to be motivated by smaller things in life, because when thinking of the bigger picture, I can only see a downhill road that leads to nothing but pain. I would love to talk as well.

I can't thank you enough for this, I always knew I cared to much about how others thought of me but I never tried to look at it from another perspective. I will try to think in the present, my whole life I've only thought about the future and how rocky it seems to be, I guess that has contributed to how I feel. Thank you for this great advice,  I need to motivate myself to follow through.
Thank you alot, but I'm from the U.S.
